title: Off-site parking facilities
previewText: For residences in Commercial and Mixed Use Districts, the provisions of Sections 25-51 and 36-42 (Off-site Spaces for Residences) shall be modified to allow the zoning lot containing required accessory off-street parking spaces for residences to be located in any zoning district, as well as anywhere within the Special Gowanus Mixed Use District.
